verdict: A near-identical rebuild at a glance with every block, text, icon and photo in place, let down by section headings 3 px too tall that push both columns 3-5 px down and a slightly shifted toolbar, on a clean, componentised auto-layout structure without shared styles.

top_defects.where: section headings (From today's featured article, Help us improve, In the news, Did you know)
top_defects.what: heading boxes 39 px tall instead of 36 px and inset ~1-2 px differently; every line below drifts 3-5 CSS px down (body starts ~y 278 vs 275, In the news items ~4 px lower), which drives most of the grid's 20-46 meanDiff cells

top_defects.where: page toolbar (Read / View source / View history / bookmark / more)
top_defects.what: the views group sits ~5 CSS px left of the reference (Read at x~746 vs ~751), bookmark and ellipsis ~2 px left; user links (Donate...) ~2 px left
Arimo instead of the reference's Arial/Helvetica: same metrics but visibly different glyph rendering at zoom; Appearance 'hide' label drawn at 14 px where the reference's is ~12-13 px
meanDiff 15.64, pctDiff 10.5 %: text lines offset by a few pixels across the two columns
no shared color or text styles/variables (styled: 0): #3366cc, #202122, box fills and borders repeated as raw values

53 absolute layers; the floated figures (frozen yogurt, Kimi Antonelli, Aracelio Iglesias) are placed outside the flow, and text nodes are wider than their parents (Summary 500 in a 498 frame, Footer links 590 in 588)

strengths: Every text of the reference is present and exact, including the bold/blue link runs, accents (Święczkowski, Bartłomiej Sochański) and the line wrapping of each paragraph
Real logo, menu, search, bookmark and ellipsis vectors, the onboarding dot and the three photos correctly cropped at their sizes
Tab, Box heading, List item and Radio option components with 20 instances, clearly named groups (Header, Page tabs, Welcome banner, Main columns, Appearance panel)
